events.title: INDOORS: Trespasser V1.0 gets a release date!

You told us what worked and what didn’t, and it shaped almost everything below. events.summary: INDOORS: Trespasser is out now!Break into the Alston Manor in the search of your dad in this short detective escape room!Even though the game is fully released, expect news on version 1.0 soon, adding some gameplay adjustments, controller support and a couple more secrets that hide in the manor.

events.title: INDOORS: Trespasser gets a release!
